subject: Any widget/package for flexible cross tables?

messages.author: 0d524fa2d2e56860
messages.subject: Any widget/package for flexible cross tables?
parts:
Hello all,

I am looking for a package or widget to create flexible data tables. I would like to create cross tables for case counting with these features:

1) Switching row/column variable: ability to click on the row/column name to select the variable (factor) for splitting
2) Filtering levels: ability to select which levels of the variable will be shown in the count table
3) Grouping levels: ability to select a group levels of  the variable and group them so that their counts are summed up
4) Splitting by a new variable: ability to split a particular cell (or all cells in a row/column) according to a new variable

This features are inspired in a comercial software called QlickView. I would like to do something simmilar with my code for Shiny. I do not undestand much about Java so I am looking for a package or similar to help me in my work.

Thanks in advance.

I provide an example to illustrate my problem.



- Data frame

ID    EYES    HAIR   SKIN   SEX
01   Brown    Dark    Dark    M
02   Brown    Blonde Rosy   F
03   Blue      Dark     Pale    M
04   Green    Blonde  Pale   F
05   Brown    Dark     Dark   F
06   Green    Red      Rosy  F

- Cross table EYES x HAIR

Brown    1            2        0        3
Green    1            0        1        2

messages.author: 6228e6a5135a9080
messages.subject: Re: Any widget/package for flexible cross tables?
parts:
Shiny is most often used together with R-code.
Take a look at the reshape2 package in R.

It allows things like:
table <-
data.frame(ID=c(1,2,3,4,5,6),EYES=c("Brown","Brown","Blue","Green","Brown","Green"),HAIR=c("Dark","Blonde","Dark","Blonde","Dark","Red"),SKIN=c("Dark","Rosy","Pale","Pale","Dark","Rosy"),SEX=
 c("M","F","M","F","F","F"))

library(reshape2)
dcast(table, EYES~HAIR)

  EYES Blonde Dark Red
 1  Blue      0    1   0
 2 Brown      1    2   0

using rowSums and colSums can get you the totals
Geef de code hier op...
